mapper.sql: SELECT CASH_FLOW_ID, STATEMENT_ID, ENTERPRISE_ID, ENTERPRISE_NAME, REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, REPORT_DATE, DATA_STATUS, DATA_SOURCE, OPERATING_CASH_INFLOW, SALES_CASH_RECEIPTS, TAX_REFUNDS_RECEIVED, OTHER_OPERATING_CASH_RECEIPTS, OPERATING_CASH_OUTFLOW, PURCHASE_CASH_PAYMENTS, EMPLOYEE_CASH_PAYMENTS, TAX_CASH_PAYMENTS, OTHER_OPERATING_CASH_PAYMENTS, OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET, INVESTING_CASH_INFLOW, INVESTMENT_RECOVERY_CASH, INVESTMENT_INCOME_CASH, ASSET_DISPOSAL_CASH, OTHER_INVESTING_CASH_RECEIPTS, INVESTING_CASH_OUTFLOW, FIXED_ASSET_CASH_PAYMENTS, INVESTMENT_CASH_PAYMENTS, OTHER_INVESTING_CASH_PAYMENTS, INVESTING_CASH_FLOW_NET, FINANCING_CASH_INFLOW, CAPITAL_CONTRIBUTION_CASH, BORROWING_CASH_RECEIPTS, OTHER_FINANCING_CASH_RECEIPTS, FINANCING_CASH_OUTFLOW, DEBT_REPAYMENT_CASH, DIVIDEND_CASH_PAYMENTS, INTEREST_CASH_PAYMENTS, OTHER_FINANCING_CASH_PAYMENTS, FINANCING_CASH_FLOW_NET, CASH_FLOW_NET_INCREASE, CASH_BEGINNING_BALANCE, CASH_ENDING_BALANCE, NET_PROFIT, DEPRECIATION_AMORTIZATION, ASSET_IMPAIRMENT_PROVISION, WORKING_CAPITAL_CHANGES, OPERATING_REVENUE, OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_REVENUE, OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_NET_PROFIT, CASH_FLOW_RATIO, CASH_FLOW_ADEQUACY_RATIO, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, DELETED, VERSION FROM CASH_FLOW_DATA
mapper.select: SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, OPERATING_CASH_INFLOW, OPERATING_CASH_OUTFLOW, OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET, SALES_CASH_RECEIPTS, PURCHASE_CASH_PAYMENTS, OPERATING_REVENUE, NET_PROFIT, OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_REVENUE, OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_NET_PROFIT, CASE WHEN OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET > 0 AND NET_PROFIT > 0 THEN 'HEALTHY' WHEN OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET > 0 AND NET_PROFIT <= 0 THEN 'CASH_POSITIVE' WHEN OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET <= 0 AND NET_PROFIT > 0 THEN 'PROFIT_POSITIVE' ELSE 'POOR' END as cashFlowQuality FROM CASH_FLOW_DATA WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, INVESTING_CASH_INFLOW, INVESTING_CASH_OUTFLOW, INVESTING_CASH_FLOW_NET, FIXED_ASSET_CASH_PAYMENTS, INVESTMENT_CASH_PAYMENTS, INVESTMENT_RECOVERY_CASH, INVESTMENT_INCOME_CASH, CASE WHEN INVESTING_CASH_FLOW_NET < 0 THEN 'EXPANSION' WHEN INVESTING_CASH_FLOW_NET > 0 THEN 'CONTRACTION' ELSE 'STABLE' END as investmentPhase FROM CASH_FLOW_DATA WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, FINANCING_CASH_INFLOW, FINANCING_CASH_OUTFLOW, FINANCING_CASH_FLOW_NET, CAPITAL_CONTRIBUTION_CASH, BORROWING_CASH_RECEIPTS, DEBT_REPAYMENT_CASH, DIVIDEND_CASH_PAYMENTS, CASE WHEN FINANCING_CASH_FLOW_NET > 0 THEN 'FINANCING' WHEN FINANCING_CASH_FLOW_NET < 0 THEN 'REPAYMENT' ELSE 'BALANCED' END as financingPhase FROM CASH_FLOW_DATA WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET, INVESTING_CASH_FLOW_NET, FINANCING_CASH_FLOW_NET, CASH_FLOW_NET_INCREASE, NET_PROFIT, OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_NET_PROFIT, CASE WHEN OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET > 0 AND INVESTING_CASH_FLOW_NET < 0 AND FINANCING_CASH_FLOW_NET < 0 THEN 'MATURE' WHEN OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET > 0 AND INVESTING_CASH_FLOW_NET < 0 AND FINANCING_CASH_FLOW_NET > 0 THEN 'GROWTH' WHEN OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET < 0 AND INVESTING_CASH_FLOW_NET < 0 AND FINANCING_CASH_FLOW_NET > 0 THEN 'STARTUP' WHEN OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET < 0 AND INVESTING_CASH_FLOW_NET > 0 AND FINANCING_CASH_FLOW_NET < 0 THEN 'DECLINE' ELSE 'OTHER' END as businessLifeCycle, CASE WHEN OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_NET_PROFIT >= 1.2 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_NET_PROFIT >= 0.8 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END as cashFlowQualityLevel FROM CASH_FLOW_DATA WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET, LAG(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET) OVER (ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD) as prevOperatingCashFlow, CASE WHEN LAG(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET) OVER (ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD) != 0 THEN ROUND((OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET - LAG(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET) OVER (ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD)) / ABS(LAG(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET) OVER (ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD)) * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END as operatingCashFlowGrowthRate, CASH_ENDING_BALANCE, LAG(CASH_ENDING_BALANCE) OVER (ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD) as prevCashBalance, CASE WHEN LAG(CASH_ENDING_BALANCE) OVER (ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD) > 0 THEN ROUND((CASH_ENDING_BALANCE - LAG(CASH_ENDING_BALANCE) OVER (ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD)) / LAG(CASH_ENDING_BALANCE) OVER (ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD) * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END as cashBalanceGrowthRate FROM CASH_FLOW_DATA WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT CASE WHEN ABS(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET) >= 1000000000 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN ABS(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET) >= 100000000 THEN 'MEDIUM' WHEN ABS(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET) >= 10000000 THEN 'SMALL' ELSE 'MICRO' END as cashFlowScale, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET) as avgOperatingCashFlow, AVG(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_REVENUE) as avgCashFlowToRevenue, COUNT(CASE WHEN OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET > 0 THEN 1 END) as positiveCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET < 0 THEN 1 END) as negativeCount FROM CASH_FLOW_DATA WHERE REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN ABS(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET) >= 1000000000 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN ABS(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET) >= 100000000 THEN 'MEDIUM' WHEN ABS(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET) >= 10000000 THEN 'SMALL' ELSE 'MICRO' END ORDER BY avgOperatingCashFlow DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATA_STATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN 1 END) as verifiedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET > 0 THEN 1 END) as positiveOperatingCashFlowCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET < 0 THEN 1 END) as negativeOperatingCashFlowCount, AVG(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET) as avgOperatingCashFlow, AVG(CASH_ENDING_BALANCE) as avgCashBalance, AVG(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_REVENUE) as avgCashFlowToRevenue, AVG(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_NET_PROFIT) as avgCashFlowToNetProfit, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as statisticsTime FROM CASH_FLOW_DATA WHERE DELETED = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATA_STATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN 1 END) as verifiedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET > 0 THEN 1 END) as positiveOperatingCashFlowCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET < 0 THEN 1 END) as negativeOperatingCashFlowCount, AVG(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET) as avgOperatingCashFlow, AVG(CASH_ENDING_BALANCE) as avgCashBalance, AVG(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_REVENUE) as avgCashFlowToRevenue, AVG(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_NET_PROFIT) as avgCashFlowToNetProfit, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as statisticsTime FROM CASH_FLOW_DATA WHERE DELETED = 0
mapper.update:
UPDATE CASH_FLOW_DATA SET OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_REVENUE = CASE WHEN OPERATING_REVENUE > 0 THEN ROUND(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET / OPERATING_REVENUE * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END, OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_NET_PROFIT = CASE WHEN NET_PROFIT > 0 THEN ROUND(OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_NET / NET_PROFIT, 2) ELSE NULL END, UPDATE_TIME =
NOW() SYSDATE
WHERE CASH_FLOW_ID = #{cashFlowId} AND DELETED = 0
